run_sample_from_lm: run the fairseq language model sampler to generate text samples from prompt files
run_sample_with_prompts: run sample.py with a prompts file and output path to generate language model samples
run_sample_debug_mode: run the language model sampler in debug mode to process only the first 10 prompts
run_sample_multiple_per_prompt: run the sampler with multiple samples per prompt using the samples-per-prompt flag
review_make_batches: review the make_batches function that encodes text lines into tokenized batches for inference
